messages:
Alex H: Taking over evening oncall (18:00-02:00 PT). Quick handoff notes below, plz skim and ack.

Alex H: What changed since morning: deployed inference-gateway v2.14.3 (non-breaking config tweak to prefetch), and a DB schema migration for job_metadata (backfilled during low traffic).

Alex H: Watchlist (priority order):
- kv-cache eviction spikes on west-region (threshold: 500 evictions/min). If you see sustained >500, flip kv-cache-policy=conservative and open a prod incident.
- prefetched-worker queue latency >250ms (see runbook).
- a small rate limiter tweak rolled out to /embeddings; errors should be <0.1% but watch 5xx trends.

Priya R: acked. I'll keep an eye on embeddings 5xx and queue latency for the first hour. If anything looks odd I'll escalate.

Matt L: FYI I pushed a tiny revert PR for a logging noise change (PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/631). Not related to runtime but wanted to surface.

DeployBot: deploy finished: inference-gateway@v2.14.3 -> prod (commit abc1234) :white_check_mark:

Javier S: Quick Q — when should we expect the kv-cache eviction metric to stabilize after the migration? Last time it took ~30m.

Alex H: Good Q. Expect ~15-30m for warmup in west. If you see another spike after 45m, treat as anomalous and ping infra.

Priya R: Also pinging @Matt L — can you watch the canary logs for the prefetch worker for the next 20m? k8s pod name pattern: prefetch-worker-*. Use this grep: `kubectl -n prod logs -l app=prefetch-worker | grep -E "(latency|error|prefetch)" -A2`

Matt L: on it, tailing now. :eyes: 

Alex H: Action items:
- Priya: monitor embeddings 5xx and report any rollbacks (if >0.5% 5xx over 5m escalate).
- Matt: watch prefetch worker logs and flag any latency >250ms.
- Javier: keep an eye on kv-cache eviction metric for west region.

Alex H: Runbook links: kv-cache playbook https://wiki.redwood.dev/runbooks/kv-cache, prefetch SLO dashboard https://dashboards.redwood.dev/prefetch-slo

Priya R: quick heads up — I saw one alert earlier for embeddings throttled (triggered at 17:46), it self-resolved after 2m. I saved the alert context in incident channel.

Alex H: thanks. No immediate mitigation needed. If it recurs, toggle embeddings fallback route to model-small and notify customers via status.

oncall-bot: reminder: please confirm coverage swap 22:00-02:00 if you plan to hand off early.

Javier S: I can cover 22:00-02:00 if needed.

Alex H: great — thanks Javier, will DM you if I need a mid-shift break.

Priya R: one last thing — code review ping for infra PR #629 (batching param fix). It's low risk but flagged in CI; requesting an eyeball from an oncall if CI flakes.

Matt L: I reviewed #629 earlier, looks OK. If CI flakes again I'll re-run.

Alex H: All right, if no blockers let's close this thread. Ping in channel for any page. :thumbsup:

Priya R: :thumbsup: 

Matt L: :thumbsup: 

Javier S: :thumbsup: 

DeployBot: notify: scheduled healthcheck in 30m (inference-gateway).

Alex H: last note — paste this into your shift notes: "v2.14.3 deployed, watch kv-cache evictions, prefreq latency, embeddings 5xx <0.5%"

Alex H: signing off to monitoring.
